bias_definition: V=(mu_L-mu_R)/e, mu_L=Ef+eV/2, mu_R=Ef-eV/2. Fixed laboratory left/right labels.
origin: Benchmark bounded controls, not claimed source calculations or calibrated tolerances.
base_geometry: Au(111), common 3x3 transverse surface repeat and four Au layers on each side of the central region. Build the same registry and equivalent terminal S contact sites for all three molecular graphs. Declare all cell vectors, electrode repeats, frozen/relaxed layers and transport axis before computation. Authentic source optimized junctions are not public starts.
required_geometry_design_records: Au lattice parameter and source/relaxed derivation
exact Au count, graph atom maps and removed thiol H maps
principal-layer atom ordering and electrode/central-region partition
reversal: Reverse the AD molecular donor/acceptor direction while retaining laboratory electrodes, contact registry, proton removal and |V|. Match Au-S distances; log unavoidable geometric differences rather than attributing them purely to polarity.
contact_perturbation: At AD_base fixed molecular internal geometry, displace the complete left electrode/contact block by 0.2 angstrom away from the left sulfur along the transport axis; keep right contact unchanged. Synchronize lead and central-region registration. This is a fixed-geometry intervention, not an unconstrained minimum.
numerical_sensitivity: At AD_base compare ±0.5 V currents/transmission with tighter k sampling/energy quadrature and a thicker screening region. Record actual input differences and resulting current floor; no invented universal tolerance.
gate: Geometry recipes specify controls but are not validated NEGF input files. Do not call unapproved TranSIESTA/TBtrans binaries. Electrode self-energies, pseudopotentials, lead matching and converged ±V execution must be verified before full matrix.
